Title: Outstanding reserve field is present
Description: Verify the generated SQ1 Claims Feed exposes the new reserve measure according to the approved output contract.
Preconditions / Test Data: Feed schema and a prepared in-scope claim with an expected reserve result are available.
Steps: 1. Generate the Claims Feed. 2. Inspect the output schema and the record for the prepared claim. 3. Compare the field name and representation with the approved contract.
Expected Results: The output contains Outstanding Reserve Amount with the approved field name and data representation; the record is traceable to the prepared claim.

Title: Reserve value follows output contract
Description: Verify reserve values conform to the agreed field-level rules, including precision and null/zero representation.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved output contract defines numeric precision, currency, nullability, and zero behavior; prepared in-scope results cover nonzero and zero values.
Steps: 1. Generate records for the prepared claims. 2. Inspect reserve field values and serialization. 3. Compare formatting, precision, and zero/null representation to the contract.
Expected Results: Each value conforms to the approved output contract without rounding or coercion beyond the documented rules.

Title: Multiple coverages remain separate
Description: Verify a claim with multiple applicable coverages has the outstanding reserve associated with the correct coverage or exposure.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared claim has at least two applicable coverage/exposure records and distinct confirmed expected reserve values.
Steps: 1. Load or identify the prepared source claim. 2. Generate the feed. 3. Match each output reserve to its coverage/exposure key and confirmed expected value.
Expected Results: Each approved coverage/exposure has the correct reserve at the approved grain; amounts are not incorrectly combined or assigned to another coverage.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC3; US2 AC4; US3 AC3
Title: Current position reflects reserve changes
Description: Verify increases and decreases produce the current position according to the finalized reserve/payment calculation rules.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared claim has multiple reserve changes and any relevant payments; finalized calculation specification and Claims SME-confirmed expected result are available.
Steps: 1. Review the source transaction timeline and approved expected result. 2. Generate the feed for the applicable reporting point. 3. Compare its amount with the approved expected result.
Expected Results: The feed matches the confirmed current outstanding position; it does not report an unapproved sum or snapshot of movement history.

Title: Feed does not emit reserve movement history
Description: Verify the enhancement adds a current reserve measure rather than additional transaction-history rows.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared claim has multiple eligible reserve movements; existing feed row grain and output contract are documented.
Steps: 1. Capture expected feed row grain for the claim. 2. Generate the enhanced feed. 3. Compare output rows and fields with the documented feed contract.
Expected Results: The feed reports the current reserve at the approved grain and does not add one output row per reserve movement unless that is already part of the approved feed contract.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC4; US2 AC4; US3 AC8
Title: Payment output remains separate and unchanged
Description: Verify adding reserve does not alter or merge the existing payment measure.
Preconditions / Test Data: Baseline feed output and prepared claim with payment activity are available; no approved payment design change exists.
Steps: 1. Generate baseline output using the approved prior version. 2. Generate enhanced output for identical source data. 3. Compare payment fields and inspect the new reserve field.
Expected Results: Existing payment values and semantics are unchanged; Outstanding Reserve Amount is a distinct measure and matches its own approved expected result.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC5; US2 AC2; US3 AC7
Title: Approved and unapproved coverage handling
Description: Verify only coverage/exposure values in the approved SQ1 coverage list are processed for the reserve output.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved coverage list is finalized; test claims exist for an included coverage and a coverage outside the list.
Steps: 1. Generate feed output for both claims. 2. Check inclusion and reserve values against the approved coverage list and output contract.
Expected Results: Included coverage follows the approved reserve rules; out-of-scope coverage is excluded from the reserve output as specified without affecting unrelated feed measures.

Title: Calculation uses reportingamount
Description: Verify the calculation uses reportingamount as the transaction amount basis.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared eligible transaction line has reportingamount different from any other available amount field; finalized calculation rules and expected result are available.
Steps: 1. Inspect the source transaction values. 2. Run the calculation/feed. 3. Reconcile the result using reportingamount and compare with the result using the other amount field as a negative control.
Expected Results: The calculated result matches the finalized rule using reportingamount; the other amount field does not drive the reserve result.

Title: Reserve subtype 2 is included
Description: Verify the reviewed required reserve subtype, including subtype 2, is not inadvertently filtered out.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved subtype scope confirms subtype 2 is eligible; prepared eligible subtype-2 transaction line has a known expected contribution.
Steps: 1. Seed or identify the subtype-2 line with other eligibility attributes valid. 2. Run the extraction/calculation. 3. Inspect selected source lines and output reconciliation.
Expected Results: Subtype 2 is selected when it satisfies the finalized eligibility rules, and its contribution agrees with the approved expected result.

Title: Indemnity reserve line is included
Description: Verify an otherwise eligible Reserve transaction with Cost Type = Indemnity contributes under the finalized calculation.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared eligible Reserve transaction has Cost Type = Indemnity and all other approved filters satisfied.
Steps: 1. Run the extraction/calculation. 2. Inspect the selected transaction set. 3. Reconcile its contribution to the output using the approved calculation specification.
Expected Results: The eligible Indemnity reserve line is included and contributes the confirmed amount.

Title: Non-Indemnity reserve line follows filter
Description: Verify a Reserve transaction with a non-Indemnity cost type does not contribute where the approved rule requires Indemnity.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared otherwise eligible Reserve transaction differs only by its non-Indemnity Cost Type; finalized filter confirms exclusion.
Steps: 1. Run the extraction/calculation. 2. Inspect selected source lines. 3. Compare output with and without the non-Indemnity line.
Expected Results: The line is excluded from the reserve calculation and does not change the output; unrelated eligible lines remain included.

Title: Retired transaction lines follow validity rule
Description: Verify transaction lines with retired values, including values not equal to 0, are handled by the finalized validity predicate.
Preconditions / Test Data: Exact validity predicate is approved; prepared lines cover retired = 0 and retired != 0, with otherwise-identical eligible attributes.
Steps: 1. Run the query for the prepared lines. 2. Inspect the selected/excluded line identifiers and predicate outcome. 3. Reconcile the result to expected output.
Expected Results: Lines identified as retired/invalid by the approved predicate are excluded; valid lines remain eligible. Behavior for each tested retired value matches the finalized rule.

Title: Other invalid transaction conditions are excluded
Description: Verify all finalized invalid transaction-line conditions besides retirement are applied.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved validity specification enumerates other invalid conditions; prepared data has one example for each condition plus a valid control line.
Steps: 1. Run the calculation against the test set. 2. Inspect selected line IDs and exclusion reasons. 3. Compare the calculation with the approved expected result.
Expected Results: Every line meeting an approved invalid condition is excluded; the valid control line is retained and the output matches expectation.

Title: Reserve/payment logic reconciles to approved result
Description: Verify reserve changes and payments are processed using the finalized calculation logic while remaining separately reported.
Preconditions / Test Data: Calculation specification is approved; prepared transaction set includes reserve changes and payment activity with SME-confirmed expected reserve and payment results.
Steps: 1. Execute the query for the prepared transaction set. 2. Independently calculate expected outputs using the approved specification. 3. Compare reserve and payment results separately.
Expected Results: Outstanding Reserve Amount and payment output each match their confirmed expected results; neither measure is substituted for or combined with the other.

Title: Database result is current position, not history
Description: Verify the extraction returns the current position at the required grain and does not expose movement history as the new output.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved reporting point and feed grain are documented; prepared claim has multiple valid transaction movements.
Steps: 1. Execute the extraction for the prepared claim. 2. Inspect result columns and row grain. 3. Compare with the approved feed contract and expected current-position result.
Expected Results: The query result provides the current calculated reserve at the required grain and does not create a movement-history output.

Title: Prepared expected values reconcile to feed
Description: Verify all prepared claims have confirmed expected amounts and actual feed results are reconciled.
Preconditions / Test Data: Policies, claims, reserves, payments, coverage details, calculation rules, and Claims SME-approved expected results are available.
Steps: 1. Run the prepared validation dataset. 2. Compare each actual feed amount with its approved expected result. 3. Record claim/coverage keys, expected value, actual value, and pass/fail evidence.
Expected Results: Every test case is traceable to an approved expected value; actual values match, or differences are captured as failures with source transaction evidence.

Title: Database aggregation uses approved coverage key
Description: Verify database aggregation groups reserve transactions at the approved coverage/exposure grain.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved grain keys are documented; one claim has two coverage/exposure keys with distinct eligible transaction sets.
Steps: 1. Query eligible source transaction lines. 2. Group/reconcile them using the approved grain keys. 3. Compare grouped results with feed records.
Expected Results: Each coverage/exposure result reconciles only to its own eligible source transactions; no cross-coverage aggregation occurs.

Title: Reserve movement sequence matches calculation oracle
Description: Verify a reserve increase followed by decrease, and any applicable payment events, produces the confirmed result.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared chronological transaction sequence and approved expected calculation are available.
Steps: 1. Inspect sequence, amounts, and relevant dates. 2. Run database calculation and feed. 3. Compare with the independently prepared approved expected result.
Expected Results: Output matches the finalized calculation at the relevant reporting point and is not based on an incorrect ordering or unapproved movement sum.

Title: Retired-line exclusion is observable in reconciliation
Description: Verify a transaction line identified as retired by the approved rule does not contribute to the result.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared claim has one eligible active line and one otherwise-equivalent line that the approved predicate identifies as retired; expected result is confirmed.
Steps: 1. Run the calculation with both lines. 2. Inspect the filtered source transaction set. 3. Reconcile the output to the expected result with the retired line excluded.
Expected Results: The retired line is absent from the eligible calculation set and does not affect the reserve; the active line is handled per specification.

Title: Open claim with active reserve
Description: Verify an open claim with an active reserve produces the confirmed current amount.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared open claim has active eligible reserve transactions and a confirmed expected amount.
Steps: 1. Run the query and feed for the open claim. 2. Inspect claim status, selected transaction lines, and output. 3. Compare to the expected amount.
Expected Results: The reserve output matches the confirmed expected amount at the approved grain; claim status does not suppress an otherwise eligible active reserve unless specified by the approved rules.

Title: Closed claim with confirmed zero reserve
Description: Verify a closed claim whose confirmed expected reserve is zero is represented according to the feed contract.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared closed claim has Claims SME-confirmed expected reserve of zero and documented zero/null/row behavior.
Steps: 1. Run the database calculation and feed. 2. Inspect the claim/coverage output. 3. Compare amount and row behavior with approved expected result and output contract.
Expected Results: The result matches the confirmed zero-reserve expectation and follows the documented representation; zero is not silently changed to null or an omitted row contrary to contract.

Title: Closed claim with nonzero expected reserve
Description: Verify a closed claim is not automatically forced to zero when its confirmed expected reserve is nonzero.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared closed claim has a Claims SME-confirmed nonzero expected result, if such a valid business case exists.
Steps: 1. Run the database calculation and feed. 2. Inspect the result. 3. Compare with the confirmed expected value.
Expected Results: The result matches the approved expected amount; closure alone does not override the finalized reserve logic. If no such case is valid, document the Claims SME decision and mark the scenario not applicable.

Title: Bodily Injury and non-Bodily Injury coverage
Description: Verify both Bodily Injury and non-Bodily Injury coverage scenarios follow the approved coverage mapping and inclusion rules.
Preconditions / Test Data: Bodily Injury ClaimCenter code/treatment and approved SQ1 coverage list are confirmed; prepared claims and expected values exist for both scenarios.
Steps: 1. Run database extraction for both scenarios. 2. Inspect mapped coverage codes and selected lines. 3. Compare feed inclusion and amounts with approved expected outcomes.
Expected Results: Each scenario is included or excluded as specified; Bodily Injury is classified using the confirmed code, and no coverage is misclassified.

Title: Payment regression against baseline
Description: Verify payment values remain unchanged after the reserve enhancement.
Preconditions / Test Data: Baseline and enhanced outputs can be generated from identical source data; no approved payment change exists.
Steps: 1. Generate baseline and enhanced feeds. 2. Match records on approved keys. 3. Compare payment fields and investigate any difference.
Expected Results: Payment outputs match baseline for equivalent records; differences are absent or individually explained by a documented approved change.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US3 AC9; US2 AC2; US2 AC3; US1 AC5
Title: Combined eligibility filters are applied
Description: Verify transaction inclusion requires all applicable finalized subtype, transaction type, cost type, validity, and coverage rules.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved eligibility specification is available; controlled records include one fully eligible line and variants failing one rule at a time.
Steps: 1. Run the database extraction. 2. Inspect selected line IDs. 3. Compare each line's inclusion with each individual finalized filter. 4. Reconcile output to expected result.
Expected Results: Only lines satisfying all applicable rules contribute; each negative-control line is excluded for the expected reason and does not alter the output.

Title: Source-to-target reserve reconciliation
Description: Verify the stored/query result and feed amount reconcile to eligible source transaction data using the approved calculation.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved calculation logic, source transaction identifiers, reporting point, grain, and expected results are available.
Steps: 1. Query source lines for the test claim and reporting point. 2. Apply approved eligibility rules. 3. Recompute the expected result using the approved calculation. 4. Compare with database output and feed.
Expected Results: Eligible source lines, database calculation result, and feed amount reconcile at the approved grain with no unexplained difference.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC2; US3 AC2; US3 AC9
Title: Joins do not duplicate reserve contributions
Description: Verify joins to claim, coverage, exposure, or payment data do not multiply eligible reserve transaction rows.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared claim has known eligible source-line IDs and relationships that could reveal one-to-many join fanout; expected amount is confirmed.
Steps: 1. Count distinct eligible source line IDs before joins. 2. Execute the production query path. 3. Compare distinct line counts and grouped contribution to the source reconciliation.
Expected Results: Each eligible source line contributes according to the approved calculation exactly as intended; join fanout does not duplicate reserve or payment contributions.

Title: No eligible transaction lines
Description: Verify behavior when a claim/coverage has no eligible reserve transaction lines.
Preconditions / Test Data: Prepared claim/coverage has no lines satisfying finalized reserve, cost type, validity, and coverage rules; output contract defines whether to emit zero, null, or no reserve record.
Steps: 1. Run the database calculation and feed. 2. Inspect the claim/coverage result. 3. Compare row presence and value with the approved no-eligible-lines behavior.
Expected Results: The result follows the approved contract exactly; excluded transactions do not create a nonzero reserve, and no undocumented default is introduced.

Story / Acceptance Criteria: US1 AC2; US2 AC2; US3 AC9
Title: Coverage identifiers remain correctly mapped
Description: Verify source coverage/exposure identifiers map to the intended output identifiers during extraction and transformation.
Preconditions / Test Data: Approved source-to-feed coverage mapping is documented; prepared records exercise distinct and similar coverage identifiers.
Steps: 1. Query source identifiers and approved mappings. 2. Generate database output and feed. 3. Compare each output key and amount to the expected mapped coverage/exposure.
Expected Results: Every output reserve is attached to the correct approved coverage/exposure key; no collision, truncation, or cross-mapping occurs.

Title: Repeated run is stable for unchanged source snapshot
Description: Verify identical source data and reporting point produce stable reserve results across repeated runs.
Preconditions / Test Data: Source snapshot, approved reporting point, and calculation configuration are fixed; no intervening source changes occur.
Steps: 1. Run the database calculation and feed. 2. Repeat with the same source snapshot and configuration. 3. Compare output keys, reserve values, and payment values.
Expected Results: Both runs produce equivalent output according to the approved determinism and feed contract; differences are explainable only by documented processing metadata.
